title: Why grief comes in waves
content: Grief rarely moves in a straight line. It's common to feel okay one moment and be hit by intense sadness the next, often triggered by something small, a smell, a song, a date on the calendar. Grief isn't something you move through once and finish; it resurfaces, often unpredictably, especially early on.
